title: DenominatorRecord
description: One raw source concept in the normalization denominator (the 725 Xtext rows collapsing to 650 unique names, plus metamodel/SHACL/validation/obligation/stdlib concepts). Every raw concept gets exactly one record classifying it. unknown/blocked/unreviewed records stay in the denominator; excluding a helper requires a rationale and reviewer and can never inflate coverage. See language-pack-design.md section 6 and plan section 11.4.

source_id.description: Stable sanitized identifier for this raw source concept, e.g. 'xtext:sysml:TransitionUsage'.

raw_name.description: The raw rule/type/rule-ID name as it appears in the source.

normalized_concept_id.description: The card concept ID this collapses into, or null when classification is 'excluded' or no card is minted.

mapping.description: The auditable disposition of this raw concept in the pack (the completeness contract). 'card': a card was minted (normalized_concept_id names it). 'helper-fold': a lexical/structural helper folded into a parent concept's grammar dependencies (mapping_target names the parent, when a carded parent references it). 'alias'/'duplicate': collapsed into another concept (mapping_target names it). 'exclusion': out of scope with rationale + reviewer. 'block': in scope but blocked from carding with rationale (e.g. a locator source not yet integrated). 'uncarded': an in-scope card-bearing concept that has NO card yet — the honest low-coverage state. A concept must never be silently dropped: absence of a record is a hard gate failure.

mapping_target.description: For 'helper-fold' the parent concept id it folds into (when a carded parent references it); for 'alias'/'duplicate' the concept id it collapses into. Absent otherwise.

source_pointer.description: Canonical repo-relative pointer (grammar section + rule name, file path, or rule ID). Never a developer-absolute path.

merged_from.description: For inherited-duplicate/alias merges: the other raw source_ids folded into the same concept (audit trail for the 725->650 collapse).

allOf.description: A 'card' mapping must name the concept it collapses into; every other mapping (uncarded/helper-fold/alias/duplicate/exclusion/block) leaves normalized_concept_id null — this is what lets an in-scope concept with no card lower coverage instead of being silently dropped.
Exclusion and dispute require accountable review.
